items.title: NEAR proposes lower inflation
items.summary: The proposal would lower annual issuance from 2.5% to 1.6% over 24 months.
items.effect: Fewer new NEAR would enter supply. The same burns and buybacks would offset a larger share of issuance.
items.next: Watch for the implementation date and whether actual issuance starts falling.

items.title: Intents fees fund NEAR buybacks
items.summary: NEAR announced that the Intents fee switch is live, with revenue supporting NEAR buybacks.
items.effect: More trading can generate more revenue for buybacks. The result depends on the fee rate, revenue capture and how much is spent.
items.next: Watch monthly revenue and recorded buybacks to see whether the effect grows.

items.title: NEAR Hackathon 2026: explore public project submissions
items.status: Submission period ended · public directory available
items.summary: NEAR Hackathon ran 1–14 November 2026. The public directory collects submitted prototypes across 13 tracks, including Investment Thesis, DeFi, privacy and the agent economy.
items.effect: Builder participation shows experimentation and breadth of ideas, but submissions are not evidence of product adoption, mainnet launch or token demand.
items.next: Browse the complete official project directory. During judging, distinguish demos from shipped products and track projects that report independent adoption.

items.title: NEAR Intents goes live inside Talos institutional trading workflow
items.summary: NEAR says Talos's order and execution management system now supports access to NEAR Intents cross-chain DeFi liquidity using existing trading desk workflows.
items.effect: The integration may make solver-sourced cross-chain liquidity easier for institutions to access. Announcement of availability alone does not establish volume or token demand.
items.next: Look for independently measurable Talos-routed volume, active institutional usage and changes in Intents fees and revenue.

items.title: near.com adds confidential PEARL trading
items.summary: NEAR announced that PEARL, an asset associated with AI compute workloads, can be traded confidentially through near.com using NEAR Intents.
items.effect: This adds a use case connecting AI-compute assets with cross-chain liquidity, but its contribution to adoption and fee generation is not yet established here.
items.next: Track supported trading pairs, verified PEARL activity and measurable contribution to Intents volume and revenue.

items.title: Chain Signatures operations move into trusted execution environments
items.summary: NEAR reports that Chain Signatures operations now run inside trusted execution environments, with verification of MPC activity recorded on-chain.
items.effect: The change may strengthen verifiability and confidence in cross-chain infrastructure. It is not direct proof of adoption or additional revenue.
items.next: Review independent implementation evidence, operational reliability and any developer or integrator uptake.

items.title: Draft proposes a NEAR Intents treasury-backed yield model
items.summary: A draft House of Stake discussion proposes redirecting a percentage of NEAR Intents protocol fees into short-term U.S. Treasury Bills, with yield funding ecosystem startups.
items.effect: If adopted, allocation rules could affect how fee revenue contributes to buybacks and other uses. The draft has no verified implementation here.
items.next: Watch for a formal proposal number, revisions, approval and any published changes to revenue allocation.
